stem:
Om dissolves a large amount of sugar in a small amount of water to make thick syrup.

Which claim names the solute and the solvent correctly?

options.text: Sugar is the solute and water is the solvent.
Sugar is the solvent and water is the solute.
Water stops being the solvent once more sugar than water is present.
Sugar is the solute only while undissolved sugar can still be seen.

teacher.key_rationale: In a solid-in-liquid solution the solid is the solute and the liquid is the solvent, even when much solid dissolves in little liquid. Swapping the names is wrong. Visibility of grains is not the test.
